artifact_scope: row scores and identities validated; file bytes/model provenance checked by execution owner
cost_scope: logical refinement tariff in objective; measured host/bridge timings descriptive and separate
primary_objective: mean hard UTF8/8-bit-PNG reward-observer utility minus 0.002 per actual refinement; common first couple is charged

secondary_ce.definition: one global log-mean-exp over the frozen seed/pair/corruption cohort, not average conditional CE

uncertainty.conditioning: three fixed historical models and this constructed source task
uncertainty.method: paired source-pair percentile bootstrap; NumPy linear quantiles
uncertainty.not_claimed: new-model/new-dataset uncertainty, finite-sample coverage, or causal timing advantage
uncertainty.resampling: same pair indices across all arms, conditions, and fixed models; splits independent
